filter: httpResponseTests of the restXml files that carry an XML body (lists, maps, structures, unions, attributes, timestamps, payload structures and the S3 unwrapped output), kept when appliesTo is not server and the output has a body member of a kind the S3 model has. Members of kinds the S3 model has none of (byte, short, float, double, blob, intEnum) are dropped from the output shapes and from the params; every other member, with its xml traits, is as the test file has it. Union members are renamed to PascalCase with the original name as xmlName. The rest are listed in `excluded` with the reason. Header-only tests are gen_respvec.test.bit.
